sections.title: In the Buddha's Words
sections.note: Bhikkhu Bodhi's anthology (Wisdom Publications), used as a structural spine: Parts I through X, roughly foundational to advanced. Translations are Bhikkhu Sujato's via SuttaCentral, unless noted otherwise.

sections.title: Suttas I return to
sections.note: Suttas outside the anthology above, encountered elsewhere, and kept coming back to. No structural spine here, just the ones that stayed.

sections.title: From practice
sections.note: Reflections that grew out of practice rather than out of a sutta.
